library(shiny)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggchemplot)

# Workaround for Chromium Issue 468227 (shinylive downloads)
downloadButton <- function(...) {
  tag <- shiny::downloadButton(...)
  tag$attribs$download <- NULL
  tag
}

parse_ids <- function(x) {
  ids <- as.integer(unlist(strsplit(x %||% "", "[^0-9]+")))
  ids[!is.na(ids)]
}

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x) || !nzchar(x)) y else x

parse_colors <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(x %||% "")
  if (!nzchar(x)) return(NULL)
  parts <- strsplit(x, "[,;]")[[1]]
  cols <- stats::setNames(
    vapply(parts, function(p) trimws(sub(".*=", "", p)), character(1)),
    vapply(parts, function(p) trimws(sub("=.*", "", p)), character(1))
  )
  cols[nzchar(names(cols)) & nzchar(cols)]
}

null_if_blank <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || !nzchar(as.character(x))) NULL else x
}

ensure_sketch_ready <- function(res) {
  if (is.null(res$params)) res$params <- list()
  if (is.null(res$params$collapse_hydrogens)) res$params$collapse_hydrogens <- FALSE
  need_a <- c("atom_id", "x", "y", "symbol", "default_color", "color",
              "charge", "radical", "show_label")
  if (!"show_label" %in% names(res$atoms))
    res$atoms$show_label <- res$atoms$symbol != "C"
  if (!"default_color" %in% names(res$atoms))
    res$atoms$default_color <- res$atoms$color
  if (!"charge" %in% names(res$atoms)) res$atoms$charge <- 0L
  if (!"radical" %in% names(res$atoms)) res$atoms$radical <- 0L
  for (col in setdiff(need_a, names(res$atoms))) {
    res$atoms[[col]] <- if (col %in% c("charge", "radical")) 0L else
      if (col == "show_label") TRUE else NA
  }
  res$atoms <- res$atoms[, need_a, drop = FALSE]
  need_b <- c("from", "to", "order", "stereo", "bond_type", "shorten_start",
              "shorten_end", "width", "wedge_thickness", "n_hashes", "colour")
  if (!is.null(res$bond_coords) && nrow(res$bond_coords)) {
    for (col in setdiff(need_b, names(res$bond_coords)))
      res$bond_coords[[col]] <- NA
    res$bond_coords <- res$bond_coords[, need_b, drop = FALSE]
  }
  res
}

chem_size_cm <- function(result, bond_length) {
  atoms <- result$atoms
  bonds <- result$bond_coords
  median_bond <- 1
  if (!is.null(bonds) && nrow(bonds) > 0) {
    lens <- sqrt((bonds$x2 - bonds$x1)^2 + (bonds$y2 - bonds$y1)^2)
    lens <- lens[is.finite(lens) & lens > 0]
    if (length(lens)) {
      med <- median(lens)
      mad_val <- stats::mad(lens, center = med, constant = 1)
      typical <- if (mad_val > 0) lens[abs(lens - med) <= 3 * mad_val] else lens
      if (length(typical)) median_bond <- median(typical)
    }
  }
  if (median_bond < 1e-6) median_bond <- 1
  x_span <- diff(range(atoms$x, na.rm = TRUE))
  y_span <- diff(range(atoms$y, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (!is.finite(x_span) || x_span < 1e-6) x_span <- 1
  if (!is.finite(y_span) || y_span < 1e-6) y_span <- 1
  list(
    width_cm = x_span * bond_length / median_bond * 1.08,
    height_cm = y_span * bond_length / median_bond * 1.08,
    median_bond = median_bond
  )
}

swatch <- function(hex) {
  ink <- tryCatch(if (sum(col2rgb(hex)) < 380) "white" else "black", error = function(e) "black")
  tags$span(
    hex,
    style = sprintf(
      "display:inline-block; margin:2px 6px 2px 0; padding:2px 6px; background:%s; color:%s; border:1px solid #ccc; font-family:monospace;",
      hex, ink
    )
  )
}

palette_row <- function(name, hexes) {
  tags$p(tags$b(name), tags$br(), lapply(hexes, swatch))
}

helper_line <- function(input) {
  ids <- parse_ids(input$atom_ids)
  idt <- if (length(ids)) paste(ids, collapse = ", ") else "integer(0)"
  label <- null_if_blank(input$prot_label)
  label_arg <- if (is.null(label)) "NULL" else sprintf("\"%s\"", label)
  note <- null_if_blank(input$note_label)
  note_arg <- if (is.null(note)) "\"\"" else sprintf("\"%s\"", note)
  side_arg <- if (identical(input$mb_side, "auto")) "NULL" else input$mb_side
  switch(
    input$helper,
    highlight_atoms = sprintf(
      "highlight_atoms(p1, c(%s), fill = \"%s\", alpha = %s, size = %s)",
      idt, input$hi_fill2, input$hi_alpha2, input$hi_size2
    ),
    show_atom_label = sprintf("show_atom_label(p1, c(%s))", idt),
    uncollapse_hydrogens = sprintf("uncollapse_hydrogens(p1, c(%s))", idt),
    place_collapsed_h = sprintf("place_collapsed_h(p1, %s, \"%s\")", input$atom_id, input$h_side),
    change_label = sprintf("change_label(p1, %s, \"%s\")", input$atom_id, input$new_label),
    delete_atom = sprintf("delete_atom(p1, %s)", input$atom_id),
    delete_bond = sprintf("delete_bond(p1, %s, %s)", input$from_id, input$to_id),
    add_atom = sprintf("add_atom(p1, %s, %s, \"%s\")", input$atom_x, input$atom_y, input$new_label),
    add_bond = sprintf("add_bond(p1, %s, %s, %s)", input$from_id, input$to_id, input$bond_order),
    add_wedge_bond = sprintf("add_wedge_bond(p1, %s, %s)", input$from_id, input$to_id),
    add_hashed_bond = sprintf("add_hashed_bond(p1, %s, %s)", input$from_id, input$to_id),
    flip_double_bond_side = sprintf("flip_double_bond_side(p1, %s, %s, side = %s)", input$from_id, input$to_id, side_arg),
    add_protein_link = sprintf(
      "add_protein_link(p1, x_start = %s, y_start = %s, length = %s, angle = %s, amplitude = %s, frequency = %s, linewidth = %s, label = %s)",
      input$atom_x, input$atom_y, input$prot_length, input$prot_angle,
      input$prot_amp, input$prot_freq, input$prot_width, label_arg
    ),
    add_atom_note = sprintf(
      "add_atom_note(p1, %s, %s, distance = %s, direction = %s, angle = %s)",
      input$atom_id, note_arg, input$note_dist, input$note_dir, input$note_angle
    ),
    add_group = sprintf(
      "add_group(p1, %s, \"%s\", orientation = %s)",
      input$group_atom, input$group_name,
      if (!nzchar(input$group_orient)) "NULL" else input$group_orient
    ),
    add_metal = sprintf(
      "add_metal(p1, %s, \"%s\", oxidation = %s)",
      input$metal_atom, input$metal_symbol, input$metal_ox
    ),
    rotate_fragment = sprintf(
      "rotate_fragment(p1, %s, %s, %s)",
      input$rot_pivot, input$rot_through, input$rot_angle
    ),
    "p1"
  )
}

h_offset_vec <- function(input) {
  h  <- input$h_off_h
  h2 <- input$h_off_h2
  vh <- input$h_off_vh
  vh2 <- input$h_off_vh2
  if (is.na(h) && is.na(h2) && is.na(vh) && is.na(vh2)) return(NULL)
  if (is.na(h)) h <- 0.3
  if (is.na(h2)) h2 <- h
  if (is.na(vh)) vh <- h * 1.15
  if (is.na(vh2)) vh2 <- h2 * 1.15
  c(h, h2, vh, vh2)
}

help_parse <- tags$div(
  tags$p("These inputs are arguments of ggchemplot1(). Changing one re-reads the source and discards table edits and helper calls."),
  tags$ul(
    tags$li(tags$b("Choose SDF"), ": V2000 structure file. Atom coordinates and the bond table come from this file."),
    tags$li(tags$b("PubChem CID"), ": downloads the structure from PubChem."),
    tags$li(tags$b("Sketch"), ": start from a template, then add groups or metals."),
    tags$li(tags$b("Collapse hydrogens"), ": hydrogens on N, O, or S become OH, NH2, or SH labels. This cannot be changed later in ggchemplot2()."),
    tags$li(tags$b("Use SDF stereo"), ": V2000 stereo codes 1 and 6 become wedge and hashed bonds. FALSE draws every bond as a plain line."),
    tags$li(tags$b("Normalize bond length"), ": scale coordinates so the median bond equals target_bond_length, in plot data units. Use the same target for every panel in a paper."),
    tags$li(tags$b("Rotation"), ": degrees, counterclockwise, applied before flips."),
    tags$li(tags$b("Flip horizontal / vertical"), ": one flip keeps absolute configuration by inverting wedges. Both flips are a 180 degree rotation and do not invert stereo."),
    tags$li(tags$b("paint_it_black"), ": ignore atom colours and draw the structure black."),
    tags$li(tags$b("custom_atom_colors"), ": element = colour. Use an R name (gold, steelblue, firebrick, forestgreen) or a hex code (#RRGGBB). Example: N=steelblue, O=firebrick.")
  )
)

help_draw <- tags$div(
  tags$p("These inputs are arguments of ggchemplot2(). They redraw the current object and do not re-read the SDF."),
  tags$ul(
    tags$li(tags$b("Title"), ": plot title. Blank leaves the title unset."),
    tags$li(tags$b("Atom labels / Hide carbon labels"), ": skeletal style omits C unless the carbon has a charge or a radical."),
    tags$li(tags$b("Atom circles / Hide carbon circles"), ": discs behind labels. atom_circle_color fills them; use atom to fill with the element colour, or transparent for no fill."),
    tags$li(tags$b("Show atom / bond ids"), ": red atom ids and blue bond ids, used by the Edit helpers. The four panels share one setting."),
    tags$li(tags$b("label_fontface / label_family / label_size"), ": typeface of element symbols. label_size is in points."),
    tags$li(tags$b("atom_size / bond_width"), ": disc size and bond width in mm. Blank derives both from label_size."),
    tags$li(tags$b("double_bond_offset"), ": gap between the strokes of a double or triple bond, in data units."),
    tags$li(tags$b("label_padding"), ": margin around the molecule so labels are not clipped."),
    tags$li(tags$b("circle_stroke"), ": border width of atom discs."),
    tags$li(tags$b("H offset"), ": four gaps for collapsed hydrogens. H horiz and H2 horiz on the first line; H vert and H2 vert on the second. Leave blank for the automatic values."),
    tags$li(tags$b("highlight_atoms"), ": disc behind the listed atom ids. Applied at draw time and written into the Code tab.")
  )
)

help_edit <- tags$div(
  tags$p("Each action shows only its own arguments. Undo restores the object from before the last helper, snippet, or table edit (up to 10 steps)."),
  tags$ul(
    tags$li(tags$b("delete_atom"), ": atom_id. Also removes bonds that touch that atom."),
    tags$li(tags$b("delete_bond"), ": from_id and to_id, the two atom ids. Order does not matter."),
    tags$li(tags$b("add_bond / add_wedge_bond / add_hashed_bond"), ": from_id and to_id. Bond order is 1, 2, or 3."),
    tags$li(tags$b("flip_double_bond_side"), ": from_id, to_id, and side. side = +1 or -1 forces the offset; auto flips the current side."),
    tags$li(tags$b("add_atom"), ": x, y, and the element symbol."),
    tags$li(tags$b("add_group"), ": atom_id, group name, optional orientation in degrees. Works on SDF and sketch results."),
    tags$li(tags$b("add_metal"), ": atom_id, element symbol, oxidation state. Works on SDF and sketch results."),
    tags$li(tags$b("rotate_fragment"), ": pivot_id stays fixed. through_id is the first atom of the piece that moves. angle is degrees, counterclockwise. Everything connected to through_id that does not cross the pivot rotates together."),
    tags$li(tags$b("add_protein_link"), ": x, y, length, angle, amplitude, frequency, linewidth, and an optional label."),
    tags$li(tags$b("add_atom_note"), ": atom_id, label, distance, direction in degrees, and letter angle.")
  )
)

help_save <- tags$div(
  tags$p("save_chemplot() sizes the file so the median bond has a chosen length on the page. The preview uses that same size. Save figure runs save_chemplot() and downloads the file."),
  tags$ul(
    tags$li(tags$b("bond_length"), ": printed length of the median bond, in centimetres."),
    tags$li(tags$b("Preview zoom"), ": screen pixels per centimetre. Leave it fixed when comparing molecules."),
    tags$li(tags$b("Preview final image"), ": writes a PNG with save_chemplot() and shows it. Scroll if it is taller than the panel.")
  )
)

help_colors <- tags$div(
  tags$p("A colour may be an R name or a hex code. names are listed by colors(): black, white, grey40, gold, orange, firebrick, forestgreen, steelblue, purple, brown. Hex codes use #RRGGBB. #RRGGBBAA adds transparency, for example #4477AA99."),
  tags$p("The chips below are colorblind-friendly palettes from ggpubfigs (Steenwyk). Copy a code into custom_atom_colors or a highlight fill."),
  palette_row("contrast_three", c("#004488", "#BB5566", "#DDAA33")),
  palette_row("ito_seven", c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73", "#CC79A7", "#56B4E9", "#E69F00", "#F0E442")),
  palette_row("bright_seven", c("#4477AA", "#228833", "#AA3377", "#BBBBBB", "#66CCEE", "#CCBB44", "#EE6677")),
  palette_row("vibrant_seven", c("#0077BB", "#EE7733", "#33BBEE", "#CC3311", "#009988", "#EE3377", "#BBBBBB")),
  palette_row("muted_nine", c("#332288", "#117733", "#CC6677", "#88CCEE", "#999933", "#882255", "#44AA99", "#DDCC77", "#AA4499")),
  tags$p("Example: N=#0072B2, O=#D55E00, S=#E69F00, P=#CC79A7")
)

          selected = "sdf"

        conditionalPanel(
          "input.source == 'sdf'",
          fileInput("sdf", NULL, buttonLabel = "Choose SDF", placeholder = "No file selected", accept = c(".sdf", ".sd"))

          tags$hr(),

          selectInput("sk_group_name", "group", choices = sketch_groups()),
          textInput("sk_group_orient", "orientation (blank = auto)", placeholder = "90"),
          actionButton("sk_add_group", "Add group"),

        sliderInput("rotation", "Rotation", -180, 180, 0, step = 15),

        checkboxInput("flip_v", "Flip vertical", FALSE),

        tags$hr(),

        actionButton("valence_draw", "Check valence", class = "btn-sm btn-info"),
        checkboxInput("show_ids_draw", "Show atom / bond ids", FALSE),
        verbatimTextOutput("valence_draw", placeholder = TRUE),
        tags$hr(),
        h4("ggchemplot2()"),
        textInput("title", "Title"),
        checkboxInput("labels", "Atom labels", TRUE),
        checkboxInput("hide_c", "Hide carbon labels", TRUE),
        checkboxInput("circles", "Atom circles", TRUE),
        checkboxInput("hide_cc", "Hide carbon circles", TRUE),
        selectInput("fontface", "label_fontface", c("plain", "bold", "italic", "bold.italic")),
        selectInput("family", "label_family", c("sans", "serif", "mono")),
        numericInput("label_size", "label_size", 12, min = 1),
        numericInput("atom_size", "atom_size (blank = auto)", NA),
        numericInput("bond_width", "bond_width (blank = auto)", NA),
        numericInput("offset", "double_bond_offset", 0.15, step = 0.01),
        numericInput("padding", "label_padding", 0.6, step = 0.1),
        numericInput("stroke", "circle_stroke", 0, step = 0.1),
        textInput("bond_color", "bond_color", "black"),

        tags$label("H offset"),

          column(6, numericInput("h_off_h2", "H2 horiz", NA, step = 0.05))
        ),

          numericInput("hi_size2", "size", 10, min = 1)
        ),
        conditionalPanel(
          "input.helper == 'place_collapsed_h' || input.helper == 'change_label' || input.helper == 'delete_atom' || input.helper == 'add_atom_note'",
          numericInput("atom_id", "atom_id", 1, min = 1)

        conditionalPanel("input.helper == 'place_collapsed_h'", selectInput("h_side", "side", c("left", "right", "up", "down"))),

          numericInput("to_id", "to_id", 2, min = 1)

        ),
        conditionalPanel("input.helper == 'add_bond'", numericInput("bond_order", "order", 1, min = 1, max = 3)),
        conditionalPanel(
          "input.helper == 'add_atom' || input.helper == 'add_protein_link'",
          numericInput("atom_x", "x", 0),
          numericInput("atom_y", "y", 0)
        ),
        conditionalPanel(
          "input.helper == 'add_protein_link'",
          numericInput("prot_length", "length", 1.8, step = 0.1),
          numericInput("prot_angle", "angle", 0, step = 15),
          numericInput("prot_amp", "amplitude", 0.15, step = 0.05),
          numericInput("prot_freq", "frequency", 4, min = 1),
          numericInput("prot_width", "linewidth", 1.35, step = 0.05),
          textInput("prot_label", "label", placeholder = "Protein")
        ),
        conditionalPanel(
          "input.helper == 'add_atom_note'",
          textInput("note_label", "label", "1"),
          numericInput("note_dist", "distance", 0.28, step = 0.02),
          numericInput("note_dir", "direction", 0, step = 15),
          numericInput("note_angle", "angle", 0, step = 15)
        ),
        conditionalPanel(
          "input.helper == 'add_group'",
          numericInput("group_atom", "atom_id", 1, min = 1),
          selectInput("group_name", "group", choices = sketch_groups()),
          textInput("group_orient", "orientation (blank = auto)", placeholder = "90")
        ),
        conditionalPanel(
          "input.helper == 'add_metal'",
          numericInput("metal_atom", "atom_id", 1, min = 1),
          textInput("metal_symbol", "metal", "Fe"),
          numericInput("metal_ox", "oxidation", 2, step = 1)
        ),
        conditionalPanel(
          "input.helper == 'rotate_fragment'",
          numericInput("rot_pivot", "pivot_id (fixed)", 1, min = 1),
          numericInput("rot_through", "through_id (starts the moving part)", 2, min = 1),
          numericInput("rot_angle", "angle (degrees)", 60, step = 15)
        ),
        actionButton("apply_helper", "Apply this action", class = "btn-warning"),
        tags$hr(),
        textAreaInput("snippet", "Or run a call on result", height = "90px", value = "delete_atom(result, 1)"),
        actionButton("run_snippet", "Run on result"),

    "Save",
    fluidRow(
      column(
        4,
        h4("save_chemplot()"),

    h3("Saving: Save tab, save_chemplot()"), help_save,

  tabPanel(
    "About",
    h3("ggchemplot"),
    tags$p("Developed by Joao Pedro Fernandes Queiroz."),
    tags$p("The viewer is an R application. The interface is Shiny. The plot system is ggplot2. Tables are from DT. This web application was created with shinylive."),
    tags$ul(
      tags$li(tags$a("R", href = "https://www.r-project.org/", target = "_blank")),
      tags$li(tags$a("Shiny", href = "https://shiny.posit.co/", target = "_blank")),
      tags$li(tags$a("shinylive", href = "https://posit-dev.github.io/r-shinylive/", target = "_blank")),
      tags$li(tags$a("ggplot2", href = "https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/", target = "_blank")),
      tags$li(tags$a("dplyr", href = "https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/", target = "_blank")),
      tags$li(tags$a("DT", href = "https://rstudio.github.io/DT/", target = "_blank"))
    ),
    h4("Author"),
    tags$ul(
      tags$li(tags$a("GitHub", href = "https://github.com/JPFQueiroz", target = "_blank")),
      tags$li(tags$a("X: @JPedroFQueiroz", href = "https://x.com/JPedroFQueiroz", target = "_blank")),
      tags$li(tags$a("The Evolutionary Biochemist", href = "https://evolutionarybiochemist.netlify.app/", target = "_blank")),
      tags$li(tags$a("Package source", href = "https://github.com/JPFQueiroz/ggchemplot", target = "_blank"))
    ),
    h4("Please cite"),
    tags$p(
      "Fernandes-Queiroz, J. P. (2026). JPFQueiroz/ggchemplot: ggchemplotApp (Version 0.4.0) [Computer software]. Zenodo. ",
      tags$a("https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23201931", href = "https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23201931", target = "_blank")
    ),
    tags$p(

      tags$a("https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20088879", href = "https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20088879", target = "_blank"),

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  session$onSessionEnded(function() stopApp())
  
  rv <- reactiveValues(
    result = NULL, msg = "Choose a source.", code_log = character(),
    hist = list(), preview = NULL, width_cm = NULL, height_cm = NULL, median_bond = NULL,
    valence = "No structure loaded.", show_ids = FALSE
  )
  
  syncing <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  observeEvent(input$show_ids_structure, {
    if (syncing()) return()
    syncing(TRUE)
    rv$show_ids <- isTRUE(input$show_ids_structure)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_ids_draw", value = rv$show_ids)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_ids_data", value = rv$show_ids)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_ids_edit", value = rv$show_ids)
    syncing(FALSE)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  observeEvent(input$show_ids_draw, {
    if (syncing()) return()
    syncing(TRUE)
    rv$show_ids <- isTRUE(input$show_ids_draw)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_ids_structure", value = rv$show_ids)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_ids_data", value = rv$show_ids)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_ids_edit", value = rv$show_ids)
    syncing(FALSE)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  observeEvent(input$show_ids_data, {
    if (syncing()) return()
    syncing(TRUE)
    rv$show_ids <- isTRUE(input$show_ids_data)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_ids_structure", value = rv$show_ids)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_ids_draw", value = rv$show_ids)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_ids_edit", value = rv$show_ids)
    syncing(FALSE)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  observeEvent(input$show_ids_edit, {
    if (syncing()) return()
    syncing(TRUE)
    rv$show_ids <- isTRUE(input$show_ids_edit)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_ids_structure", value = rv$show_ids)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_ids_draw", value = rv$show_ids)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_ids_data", value = rv$show_ids)
    syncing(FALSE)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  
  push_state <- function() {
    if (!is.list(rv$result)) return()
    rv$hist <- c(rv$hist, list(list(result = rv$result, code_log = rv$code_log)))
    if (length(rv$hist) > 10) rv$hist <- rv$hist[-1]
  }
  
  do_undo <- function() {
    if (!length(rv$hist)) {
      rv$msg <- "Nothing to undo."
      return()
    }
    prev <- rv$hist[[length(rv$hist)]]
    rv$hist <- rv$hist[-length(rv$hist)]
    rv$result <- prev$result
    rv$code_log <- prev$code_log
    rv$msg <- "Undone."
  }
  
  observeEvent(input$undo_structure, do_undo())
  observeEvent(input$undo_draw, do_undo())
  observeEvent(input$undo_data, do_undo())
  observeEvent(input$undo_edit, do_undo())
  
  update_valence <- function() {
    if (!is.list(rv$result)) {
      rv$valence <- "No structure loaded."
      return()
    }
    tab <- tryCatch(check_valence(rv$result, only_problems = TRUE), error = function(e) e)
    if (inherits(tab, "error")) {
      rv$valence <- conditionMessage(tab)
    } else if (!nrow(tab)) {
      rv$valence <- "All atoms OK."
    } else {
      rv$valence <- paste(capture.output(print(tab, row.names = FALSE)), collapse = "\n")
    }
  }
  
  observeEvent(input$valence_structure, update_valence())
  observeEvent(input$valence_draw, update_valence())
  observeEvent(input$valence_data, update_valence())
  observeEvent(input$valence_edit, update_valence())
  
  output$valence_structure <- output$valence_draw <- output$valence_data <- output$valence_edit <- renderText(rv$valence)
  
  load_from_sdf <- function(path) {
    rv$code_log <- character()
    rv$hist <- list()
    rv$preview <- NULL
    rv$result <- tryCatch(
      ggchemplot1(
        sdf_file = path,
        use_sdf_stereo = isTRUE(input$stereo),
        collapse_hydrogens = isTRUE(input$collapse),
        rotation = input$rotation,
        flip_horizontal = isTRUE(input$flip_h),
        flip_vertical = isTRUE(input$flip_v),
        paint_it_black = isTRUE(input$black),
        normalize = isTRUE(input$normalize),
        target_bond_length = input$target,
        custom_atom_colors = parse_colors(input$colors)
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    rv$msg <- if (inherits(rv$result, "error")) conditionMessage(rv$result) else "Loaded SDF."
  }
  
  observeEvent(input$sdf, {
    if (input$source != "sdf") return()
    if (is.null(input$sdf) || !nzchar(input$sdf$datapath)) {
      rv$result <- NULL
      rv$msg <- "Choose an SDF file."
      return()
    }
    load_from_sdf(input$sdf$datapath)
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$load_cid, {
    if (!nzchar(input$cid)) {
      rv$msg <- "Enter a PubChem CID."
      return()
    }
    rv$code_log <- character()
    rv$hist <- list()
    rv$preview <- NULL
    rv$result <- tryCatch(
      ggchemplot1(
        pubchem_cid = input$cid,
        use_sdf_stereo = isTRUE(input$stereo),
        collapse_hydrogens = isTRUE(input$collapse),
        rotation = input$rotation,
        flip_horizontal = isTRUE(input$flip_h),
        flip_vertical = isTRUE(input$flip_v),
        paint_it_black = isTRUE(input$black),
        normalize = isTRUE(input$normalize),
        target_bond_length = input$target,
        custom_atom_colors = parse_colors(input$colors)
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    rv$msg <- if (inherits(rv$result, "error")) conditionMessage(rv$result) else paste("Loaded CID", input$cid)
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$create_sketch, {
    rv$code_log <- character()
    rv$hist <- list()
    rv$preview <- NULL
    rv$result <- tryCatch(
      sketch_molecule(input$template, charge = input$sketch_charge),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    rv$msg <- if (inherits(rv$result, "error")) conditionMessage(rv$result) else paste("Sketched", input$template)
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$sk_add_group, {
    req(is.list(rv$result))
    orient <- if (nzchar(input$sk_group_orient)) as.numeric(input$sk_group_orient) else NULL
    res <- tryCatch(
      add_group(ensure_sketch_ready(rv$result), input$sk_group_atom, input$sk_group_name, orientation = orient),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    if (inherits(res, "error")) {
      rv$msg <- conditionMessage(res)
    } else {
      push_state()
      rv$code_log <- c(rv$code_log, sprintf(
        "add_group(p1, %s, \"%s\", orientation = %s)",
        input$sk_group_atom, input$sk_group_name,
        if (is.null(orient)) "NULL" else orient
      ))
      rv$result <- res
      rv$msg <- paste("Added", input$sk_group_name)
    }
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$sk_add_metal, {
    req(is.list(rv$result))
    res <- tryCatch(
      add_metal(ensure_sketch_ready(rv$result), input$sk_metal_atom, input$sk_metal_symbol, oxidation = input$sk_metal_ox),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    if (inherits(res, "error")) {
      rv$msg <- conditionMessage(res)
    } else {
      push_state()
      rv$code_log <- c(rv$code_log, sprintf(
        "add_metal(p1, %s, \"%s\", oxidation = %s)",
        input$sk_metal_atom, input$sk_metal_symbol, input$sk_metal_ox
      ))
      rv$result <- res
      rv$msg <- paste("Added", input$sk_metal_symbol)
    }
  })
  
  observeEvent(
    list(input$collapse, input$stereo, input$normalize, input$target,
         input$rotation, input$flip_h, input$flip_v, input$black, input$colors),
    {
      if (input$source == "sdf" && !is.null(input$sdf) && nzchar(input$sdf$datapath)) {
        load_from_sdf(input$sdf$datapath)
      } else if (input$source == "pubchem" && nzchar(input$cid)) {
        rv$code_log <- character()
        rv$hist <- list()
        rv$result <- tryCatch(
          ggchemplot1(
            pubchem_cid = input$cid,
            use_sdf_stereo = isTRUE(input$stereo),
            collapse_hydrogens = isTRUE(input$collapse),
            rotation = input$rotation,
            flip_horizontal = isTRUE(input$flip_h),
            flip_vertical = isTRUE(input$flip_v),
            paint_it_black = isTRUE(input$black),
            normalize = isTRUE(input$normalize),
            target_bond_length = input$target,
            custom_atom_colors = parse_colors(input$colors)
          ),
          error = function(e) e
        )
        if (!inherits(rv$result, "error")) rv$msg <- paste("Reloaded CID", input$cid)
      }
    },
    ignoreInit = TRUE
  )
  
  draw_plot <- reactive({
    res <- rv$result
    validate(need(is.list(res), rv$msg %||% "No structure."))
    ids <- parse_ids(input$highlight)
    if (length(ids)) {
      res <- highlight_atoms(res, ids, fill = input$hi_fill, alpha = input$hi_alpha, size = input$hi_size)
    }
    ggchemplot2(
      res,
      title = null_if_blank(input$title),
      show_atom_labels = isTRUE(input$labels),
      hide_carbon_labels = isTRUE(input$hide_c),
      show_atom_circles = isTRUE(input$circles),
      hide_carbon_circles = isTRUE(input$hide_cc),
      show_ids = isTRUE(rv$show_ids),
      label_fontface = input$fontface,
      label_family = input$family,
      label_size = input$label_size,
      atom_size = if (is.na(input$atom_size)) NULL else input$atom_size,
      bond_width = if (is.na(input$bond_width)) NULL else input$bond_width,
      double_bond_offset = input$offset,
      label_padding = input$padding,
      circle_stroke = input$stroke,
      bond_color = input$bond_color,
      atom_circle_color = input$circle_color,
      H_offset = h_offset_vec(input),
      paint_it_black = isTRUE(input$black)
    )
  })
  
  output$chemplot <- output$chemplot2 <- output$chemplot3 <- output$chemplot_data <- renderPlot(print(draw_plot()), res = 110)
  output$status <- output$edit_msg <- renderText(rv$msg)
  
  output$atoms_table <- renderDT({
    req(is.list(rv$result))
    datatable(rv$result$atoms, editable = TRUE, options = list(pageLength = 8, scrollX = TRUE))
  })
  output$bonds_table <- renderDT({
    req(is.list(rv$result))
    datatable(rv$result$bond_coords, editable = TRUE, options = list(pageLength = 8, scrollX = TRUE))
  })
  output$h_table <- renderDT({
    req(is.list(rv$result))
    h <- rv$result$h_labels
    if (is.null(h) || !nrow(h)) h <- data.frame(note = "No collapsed hydrogens")
    datatable(h, editable = TRUE, options = list(pageLength = 8, scrollX = TRUE))
  })
  output$params <- renderPrint({
    req(is.list(rv$result))
    rv$result$params
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$atoms_table_cell_edit, {
    push_state()
    rv$result$atoms <- editData(rv$result$atoms, input$atoms_table_cell_edit)
    rv$msg <- "Atoms updated."
  })
  observeEvent(input$bonds_table_cell_edit, {
    push_state()
    rv$result$bond_coords <- editData(rv$result$bond_coords, input$bonds_table_cell_edit)
    rv$msg <- "Bonds updated."
  })
  observeEvent(input$h_table_cell_edit, {
    if (!is.null(rv$result$h_labels) && nrow(rv$result$h_labels)) {
      push_state()
      rv$result$h_labels <- editData(rv$result$h_labels, input$h_table_cell_edit)
      rv$msg <- "Collapsed-hydrogen table updated."
    }
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$apply_helper, {
    res <- rv$result
    req(is.list(res))
    ids <- parse_ids(input$atom_ids)
    side <- if (identical(input$mb_side, "auto")) NULL else as.integer(input$mb_side)
    res <- tryCatch(
      switch(
        input$helper,
        highlight_atoms = highlight_atoms(res, ids, fill = input$hi_fill2, alpha = input$hi_alpha2, size = input$hi_size2),
        show_atom_label = show_atom_label(res, ids),
        uncollapse_hydrogens = uncollapse_hydrogens(res, ids),
        place_collapsed_h = place_collapsed_h(res, input$atom_id, input$h_side),
        change_label = change_label(res, input$atom_id, input$new_label),
        delete_atom = delete_atom(res, input$atom_id),
        delete_bond = delete_bond(res, input$from_id, input$to_id),
        add_atom = add_atom(res, input$atom_x, input$atom_y, input$new_label),
        add_bond = add_bond(res, input$from_id, input$to_id, input$bond_order),
        add_wedge_bond = add_wedge_bond(res, input$from_id, input$to_id),
        add_hashed_bond = add_hashed_bond(res, input$from_id, input$to_id),
        flip_double_bond_side = flip_double_bond_side(res, input$from_id, input$to_id, side = side),
        add_protein_link = add_protein_link(
          res, x_start = input$atom_x, y_start = input$atom_y,
          length = input$prot_length, angle = input$prot_angle,
          amplitude = input$prot_amp, frequency = input$prot_freq,
          linewidth = input$prot_width, label = null_if_blank(input$prot_label)
        ),
        add_atom_note = add_atom_note(
          res, input$atom_id, input$note_label,
          distance = input$note_dist, direction = input$note_dir, angle = input$note_angle
        ),
        add_group = add_group(
          ensure_sketch_ready(res), input$group_atom, input$group_name,
          orientation = if (nzchar(input$group_orient)) as.numeric(input$group_orient) else NULL
        ),
        add_metal = add_metal(
          ensure_sketch_ready(res), input$metal_atom, input$metal_symbol, oxidation = input$metal_ox
        ),
        rotate_fragment = rotate_fragment(
          res, input$rot_pivot, input$rot_through, input$rot_angle
        ),
        res
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    if (inherits(res, "error")) {
      rv$msg <- conditionMessage(res)
    } else {
      push_state()
      rv$code_log <- c(rv$code_log, helper_line(input))
      rv$result <- res
      rv$msg <- paste("Applied", input$helper)
    }
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$run_snippet, {
    req(is.list(rv$result))
    res <- tryCatch(eval(parse(text = input$snippet), envir = list(result = rv$result)), error = function(e) e)
    if (inherits(res, "error")) {
      rv$msg <- conditionMessage(res)
    } else if (!is.list(res) || is.null(res$atoms)) {
      rv$msg <- "The call must return the ggchemplot result list."
    } else {
      push_state()
      rv$code_log <- c(rv$code_log, input$snippet)
      rv$result <- res
      rv$msg <- "Snippet applied."
    }
  })
  
  save_file_name <- reactive({
    name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(input$filename)
    paste0(name, ".", input$ext)
  })
  
  output$save_call <- renderText({
    sprintf(
      "save_chemplot(\n  result = p1,\n  plot = p,\n  filename = \"%s\",\n  bond_length = %s,\n  dpi = %s,\n  bg = \"%s\"\n)",
      save_file_name(), input$bond_cm, input$dpi, input$bg
    )
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$preview, {
    req(is.list(rv$result))
    plot <- tryCatch(draw_plot(), error = function(e) e)
    if (inherits(plot, "error")) {
      rv$msg <- conditionMessage(plot)
      return()
    }
    dest <- file.path(tempdir(), "ggchemplot_preview.png")
    sz <- chem_size_cm(rv$result, input$bond_cm)
    rv$msg <- tryCatch(
      {
        save_chemplot(
          result = rv$result, plot = plot, filename = dest,
          bond_length = input$bond_cm, dpi = 144,
          bg = if (identical(input$bg, "transparent")) "white" else input$bg
        )
        rv$preview <- dest
        rv$width_cm <- sz$width_cm
        rv$height_cm <- sz$height_cm
        rv$median_bond <- sz$median_bond
        sprintf(
          "Preview %.2f x %.2f cm. Median bond %.3f data units = %.2f cm.",
          sz$width_cm, sz$height_cm, sz$median_bond, input$bond_cm
        )
      },
      error = function(e) conditionMessage(e)
    )
  })
  
  output$final_image <- renderImage({
    req(rv$preview, file.exists(rv$preview), rv$width_cm, rv$height_cm)
    px <- input$px_per_cm
    list(
      src = rv$preview,
      contentType = "image/png",
      width = round(rv$width_cm * px),
      height = round(rv$height_cm * px),
      alt = "Saved figure preview"
    )
  }, deleteFile = FALSE)
  
  output$preview_note <- renderUI({
    req(rv$width_cm, rv$height_cm)
    tags$p(sprintf(
      "Shown at %s px/cm. File size %.2f x %.2f cm. Scroll the box if the molecule is larger than the panel.",
      input$px_per_cm, rv$width_cm, rv$height_cm
    ))
  })
  
  output$save_dl <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() save_file_name(),
    content = function(file) {
      req(is.list(rv$result))
      p <- draw_plot()
      save_chemplot(
        rv$result, plot = p, filename = file,
        bond_length = input$bond_cm, dpi = input$dpi, bg = input$bg
      )
    },
    contentType = switch(
      input$ext,
      png = "image/png",
      pdf = "application/pdf",
      "image/svg+xml"
    )
  )
  
  output$save_msg <- renderText(rv$msg)
  
  output$repro <- renderText({
    src <- if (input$source == "sdf" && !is.null(input$sdf)) input$sdf$name else if (input$source == "pubchem") paste0("CID:", input$cid) else paste0("sketch:", input$template)
    cols <- parse_colors(input$colors)
    col_line <- if (is.null(cols)) "" else sprintf(
      ",\n  custom_atom_colors = c(%s)",
      paste(sprintf("\"%s\" = \"%s\"", names(cols), cols), collapse = ", ")
    )
    hops <- h_offset_vec(input)
    hop_line <- if (is.null(hops)) "" else sprintf(",\n    H_offset = c(%s)", paste(hops, collapse = ", "))
    ids <- parse_ids(input$highlight)
    hi <- if (!length(ids)) "" else sprintf(
      "\np1 <- highlight_atoms(p1, c(%s), fill = \"%s\", alpha = %s, size = %s)",
      paste(ids, collapse = ", "), input$hi_fill, input$hi_alpha, input$hi_size
    )
    edits <- if (!length(rv$code_log)) "" else paste0("\n", paste(paste0("p1 <- ", rv$code_log), collapse = "\n"))
    sprintf(
      paste0(
        "library(ggchemplot)\nlibrary(ggplot2)\n\n",
        "# source: %s\n",
        "p1 <- ggchemplot1(\n  sdf_file = \"%s\",\n  collapse_hydrogens = %s,\n  use_sdf_stereo = %s,\n",
        "  normalize = %s,\n  target_bond_length = %s,\n  rotation = %s,\n",
        "  flip_horizontal = %s,\n  flip_vertical = %s,\n  paint_it_black = %s%s\n)%s%s\n\n",
        "p <- p1 |>\n  ggchemplot2(\n    title = %s,\n    show_atom_labels = %s,\n    hide_carbon_labels = %s,\n",
        "    show_atom_circles = %s,\n    hide_carbon_circles = %s,\n    show_ids = %s,\n",
        "    label_fontface = \"%s\",\n    label_family = \"%s\",\n    label_size = %s,\n",
        "    atom_size = %s,\n    bond_width = %s,\n    double_bond_offset = %s,\n",
        "    label_padding = %s,\n    circle_stroke = %s,\n    bond_color = \"%s\",\n",
        "    atom_circle_color = \"%s\",\n    paint_it_black = %s%s\n  )\n\n",
        "save_chemplot(\n  result = p1,\n  plot = p,\n  filename = \"%s\",\n  bond_length = %s,\n  dpi = %s,\n  bg = \"%s\"\n)"
      ),
      src, src, isTRUE(input$collapse), isTRUE(input$stereo), isTRUE(input$normalize),
      input$target, input$rotation, isTRUE(input$flip_h), isTRUE(input$flip_v),
      isTRUE(input$black), col_line, hi, edits,
      if (nzchar(input$title)) sprintf("\"%s\"", input$title) else "NULL",
      isTRUE(input$labels), isTRUE(input$hide_c), isTRUE(input$circles), isTRUE(input$hide_cc),
      isTRUE(rv$show_ids), input$fontface, input$family, input$label_size,
      if (is.na(input$atom_size)) "NULL" else input$atom_size,
      if (is.na(input$bond_width)) "NULL" else input$bond_width,
      input$offset, input$padding, input$stroke, input$bond_color, input$circle_color,
      isTRUE(input$black), hop_line, save_file_name(), input$bond_cm, input$dpi, input$bg
    )
  })
}
